shared_elements: animal/creature figures in profile with heads and snouts
low-relief carved figures against a plain ground
justification: A shows two quadrupedal animals in profile, one above the other, on a plain pillar face, with no human element; B shows an elaborately costumed frontal anthropomorphic figure with outspread feathered wings, headdress and held implements, plus small subsidiary faces. The only correspondence is the generic use of low-relief profile creature heads and a plain background, which any tradition could produce independently; the subject matter, composition and level of ornamental elaboration are entirely different.
